# Theme gallery

<!-- Generated by tests/ThemeProvider.UITests/Gallery. Edit GalleryCatalog.cs, not this file. -->

Every theme in `ThemeRegistry.AllThemes` as Dear ImGui draws it through `ImGuiPaletteMapper`, rendered headlessly by the UI test harness. Each picture is the same sample window: common widgets, a table, semantic text, and the theme's full semantic palette, one row per meaning and one swatch per priority. The pictures are regenerated on every successful build of `main`, so they show the current palettes.

## Overview

Every theme on one page, each drawn in its own background colour with its name in its own text colour, followed by its neutral ramp from very low to very high priority and one chip for each accent meaning (primary, alternate, success, call to action, information, caution, warning, error, failure and debug) at medium priority.

![Overview](overview.png)
